0022600002.text: Both the Philadelphia 76ers and New York Knicks open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the 76ers on the road. The 76ers will be missing Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, while Adem Bona (foot sprain) and Anfernee Simons (hamstring) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams split their four 2025-26 regular-season meetings, but the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, most recently falling 144-114 in Philadelphia on May 10, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win.
